name: social_research
summary: What people say on X (Twitter) or TikTok (comments) about a topic, person, brand or product ('was sagen die Leute auf X / TikTok über …', 'how do people react to …'): themes, the pro/contra split, quotes with links. Also a brand's active ads in the Meta (Facebook / Instagram) Ad Library (site facebook_ads). For Reddit use reddit_research.

args.question: string: what to find out, self-contained, in the user's language
args.country: string: country code for facebook_ads (default AT)
